text:
morgan: Heads-up — repro for weird KV growth on long chats with Qwen-2-32k (MQA) on the new kernel selector. Memory keeps climbing past expected working set, eviction doesn't seem to kick.

priya: How long are the contexts? any rope scaling factors applied? :thinking:

morgan: 50k+ tokens in a loop test (simulate streaming multi-user). rope_scale=1.0 default. I ran with both GQA and MQA profiles, growth only shows up under MQA.

juan: Can you paste the small perf dump? curious whether pages are being pinned or re-allocated.

morgan: paste logs:
```
[pid 4123] alloc_kv_page(4096) -> 0x7f9b3c...
[pid 4123] kv_slot_write(seq=12345, size=1024)
[pid 4123] kv_page_evicted -> false (candidate list empty)
[... repeated every ~2k tokens ...]
```
Notably we see repeated alloc_kv_page without corresponding evict free increments.

rachel: That looks like the page freelist isn't being repopulated. Did we recently change the KV-compact path in the MQA kernel switch? That would explain MQA-only.

alex: I ran a quick experiment and toggled `prefer_compact_on_eviction=false` in the runtime config. Memory stabilized for a short run, but throughput dropped ~6% — looks like compacting prevented reuse and instead we were triggering allocations.

priya: Interesting. Could be an interaction: MQA uses denser slot packing but relies on in-place compaction to free pages. If compaction path fails (race or kernel mismatch) new pages get allocated instead.

juan: Also watch rope scaling math — MQA maps tokens -> slot indices differently when using multi-query. If we mis-handle scaled positions we might be ending up with duplicate entries for the same key under different computed slots, preventing hits and preventing frees.

morgan: I added an assert in KV write to detect duplicate keys within active window. Saw many duplicates with slightly different slot_ids (off by 1 or off by factor when sequence wraps).

rachel: Can we repro with Llama and Mistral variants to narrow whether it's Qwen-specific? I suspect model-specific attention layout interacts with kernel tiling.

morgan: Quick notes: Llama-2-13b (GQA) — no growth. Mistral-7B (GQA) — no growth. Qwen-2-32k (MQA) — growth. Qwen-2-32k (forced GQA emulation) — growth reduced but not eliminated.

alex: Profiled kernel selection events; we see frequent kernel opcode switches around kv write paths when sequence length > 8k. Each switch triggers a `kv_write_slowpath` lock and sometimes skips freelist flip. Suspect a bug in the selector state machine.

priya: TODOs:
- Add deterministic unit that fuzzes rope-index calculation across MQA/GQA (morgan)
- Add extra freelist diagnostics in eviction path and log freelist depth on every evict attempt (juan)
- Add test to force kernel switches at boundaries and assert freelist invariants (rachel)

ops-bot: Deployed morgan's debug build to canary (canary-3) for a limited pool.

morgan: After canary run with more logging: found a race where `page_list_tail` occasionally becomes NULL between `evict_try()` and `free_list_push()` due to hoisting by the kernel selector thread. Patch incoming.

juan: Nice catch. If we guard that path and add a micro-bench for compaction cost, we can judge trade-offs (memory vs latency).

rachel: Also communicate to model-onboarding that Qwen MQA requires a slightly different compaction threshold — we'll add a model-override until we fully fix.

morgan: I'll open a PR with the lock fix + diagnostic flags and include VDOM traces. Will also attach the short repro harness.

alex: Thanks — once PR is up, let's run the nightly long-context suite and see if the mem trend disappears. :thumbsup:

morgan: PR link: https://git.company/repo/pull/1234 (contains logs and micro repro). Will follow up with perf graphs.

priya: Great, moving to review.
